reviews.title: Cumbersome and Inaccurate
reviews.text: In theory, this would be a useful app. In practice, it has been an exercise in frustration. Food quantities are basically all in grams, so I was constantly converting ounces or tablespoons or whatever. Also, you can’t be precise about your serving size. If the app thinks a serving of something is the gram equivalent of 4 ounces, but I ate 3 ounces, there’s no way to track that. You can halve a serving, or increase by halves, but that’s it. Just not practical for me. And the AI scanner is laughably inaccurate. A waste of money.
